title: The Complete Advancement Drop Randomizer & Multiplier
description: Your drop multiplier doubles with every advancement earned - on top of fully randomised drops.
body:
# The Complete Advancement Drop Randomizer & Multiplier

Every advancement you earn permanently doubles your drop multiplier - on top of fully randomised drops. Progress through the game, watch your multiplier climb, and reroll the drop pool whenever you want.

## Features
- **1000+ blocks** all have randomized drops
- **Mob drops** are randomized too
- **Fishing** drops are randomized too
- **256 possible drop configurations** - reroll as many times as you want with `/function randomizer:reroll`
- **Every advancement doubles** your drop multiplier - permanently
- **Bossbar** shows your current multiplier at all times
- **Per-player tracking** - each player has their own multiplier
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things and earning advancements
4. Run `/function randomizer:reroll` whenever you want new mappings
5. If adding to an existing world, run `/function adv_multiplier:recalculate` as each player to sync

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
